title: Blackland Lease & New City Office Plans
summary:
*   City officials discussed plans for leasing property to the Blackland Community Development Corporation.
*   A work session was held to review initial designs for a new municipal office complex.
*   The meeting centered on significant urban development and city infrastructure topics.

Council Chambers, 307 West Second Street, Austin, Texas Memorandum To: Mayor Cooksey
called to order the meeting scheduled for 4:00 on February 11, 1986, noting the absence of
Councilmember Rose.
Purpose of the meeting was to hold a work session on strategic planning, including
Economic Development Commission in the comprehensive planning process. The meeting was
adjourned at 5 p.m.
Mayor Cooksey called to order the meeting scheduled for 4:00 on February 12, 1986, noting
the presence of all Councilmembers. CITY MANAGER REPORT Paula Phillips presented a City
Manager Report on Lease of Property to the Blackland Community Development Corporation.
WORK SESSION Council held a work session on the municipal office complex design.
Transcript of work session is on file in City Clerk's office.
The meeting was adjourned at 6:20 p.m.
